reason: Rank source-local changes first: scratch lifetime and the W-register counter change are bounded edits with lower correctness risk, though neither has evidence of a speedup. Reordering ZA operations risks FP32 tolerance. The B-panel layout is distinct from the measured full-B packing, but adds packing and needs coordinated stride, traversal, and C-address changes; benefit is unverified. Transpose fusion has the highest mapping and accumulator risk. The last two proposals are the same N=64 helper experiment and both require a helper that is not supplied, so neither is currently implementable; their measured N=32 predecessor showed no repeatable gain.
